instruction: Click the top button of the alarm-clock with large numbers

source.instruction: Click the top button of the alarm-clock with large numbers

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the alarm, which was at x = +15 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point right gripper downward, raise slightly, and move to (16, -18, 95) directly above the button.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-15, +1, +1) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +21 cm (vertical) from the alarm

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -19, 95) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Close right gripper to form a pressing tip.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +21 cm (vertical) from the alarm; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (16, -19, 95) opening 0.00; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move right gripper slightly forward and down to z=91.5 to press the top button.
